_comment: Two pricing profiles. `models` (top level) is the API rate card, in USD per 1M tokens, and is the default profile ('api'); it applies only to API billing. `profiles['codex-credits']` is the Codex plan rate card, in CREDITS per 1M tokens, and is what a ChatGPT-authenticated worker actually spends. Never guess a value: a null means 'not published / unknown' and every consumer prints 'unknown' rather than inventing a number.

gpt-6-astra.note: The page states: 'Prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output for the full request.' This contradicts the shake-bench plan's H1 assumption that gpt-6-astra has no long-context multiplier; the published page wins.

gpt-5.6-sol.note: The model page publishes 2x input and 1.5x output above 272K. The 2x cached-input and cache-write multipliers derive from the prompt-caching guide's 0.1x read and 1.25x write ratios applied to the applicable uncached input rate.

gpt-5.6-terra.note: The model page publishes 2x input and 1.5x output above 272K. The 2x cached-input and cache-write multipliers derive from the prompt-caching guide's 0.1x read and 1.25x write ratios applied to the applicable uncached input rate.

gpt-5.6-luna.note: The model page publishes 2x input and 1.5x output above 272K. The 2x cached-input and cache-write multipliers derive from the prompt-caching guide's 0.1x read and 1.25x write ratios applied to the applicable uncached input rate.

api.label: API rate card (USD per 1M tokens)
api.appliesTo: API-key billing only. A ChatGPT-authenticated (auth_mode chatgpt) worker is NOT billed this way; for that worker every USD figure is a shadow cost.

codex-credits.label: Codex plan rate card (credits per 1M tokens)
codex-credits.appliesTo: ChatGPT-login (auth_mode chatgpt) Codex usage, which is what the replay worker runs on. This is the real cost of a replay.
notes: Official Codex pricing, fetched 2026-09-12 from https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing.
Fast mode: 'Fast mode applies a 2.5x multiplier to Astra's Standard rate.' The multiplier is applied to every term of the request (input, cached input, output).
No long-context multiplier is published: the API rate card's 272K 2x input / 2x cached / 1.5x output rule does not appear on the Codex pricing page and is not applied in this profile.
No cache-write charge is published: cacheWriteInputPerMTok is 0.

gpt-6-astra.note: Page quotes 250 credits per 1M input, 25 per 1M cached input, 1,250 per 1M output, and 'Fast mode applies a 2.5x multiplier to Astra's Standard rate.' No long-context term and no cache-write term appear anywhere on the page.

gpt-5.6-sol.note: Page quotes 100 / 10 / 500 credits per 1M input / cached input / output. The 2.5x Fast multiplier is stated for Astra only, so fastMultiplier is null (unknown) here rather than 2.5.

gpt-5.6-terra.note: Page quotes 50 / 5 / 300 credits per 1M input / cached input / output. Fast multiplier not published for this model.

gpt-5.6-luna.note: Page quotes 5 / 0.5 / 30 credits per 1M input / cached input / output. Fast multiplier not published for this model.
